name: What is the typical lifespan of sliding door rollers and tracks?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of sliding door rollers and tracks?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of sliding door rollers and tracks varies widely based on material quality, usage frequency, and maintenance. High-quality rollers and well-maintained tracks can last 10-20 years or more. However, heavy use, exposure to harsh weather, or neglect can significantly shorten this lifespan, sometimes requiring replacement within a few years. Regular cleaning and lubrication can extend their durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lifespan varies from 10-20+ years, depending on material, usage, and maintenance. Regular care extends durability.
